claims.remediation: Restore capacity to 100 and reject capacities below 1 at startup; regression tests demonstrate zero and negative rejection and acceptance for capacities 1 and 100.
claims.root_cause: The configuration rollout allowed queue_capacity=0 without startup validation, causing all enqueue operations to reject.
claims.statement: SYNTHETIC DemoQueue configuration incident; assess internal fixture consistency only, not a real-world incident.
claims.timeline: On 2026-10-01 UTC, queue submissions failed at 10:05, alert fired 10:06, reproduction at 10:08, fix at 10:15, recovery 10:18 and clean observation through 10:25.

citations.quote: Change record at 10:15: startup rejects capacity below 1 before accepting traffic; production demonstration configuration restored queue_capacity=100.
Regression test report at 10:17: capacity 0 rejected on startup (PASS); capacity -1 rejected (PASS); capacity 1 accepts one item (PASS); capacity 100 accepts item (PASS).
Repeat reproducer after change: invalid zero capacity prevented at startup, healthy configuration accepted submission. These tests address the misconfiguration cause.
Diagnostic log at 10:08: configured queue_capacity=0; enqueue rejected because capacity was zero.
Root cause: a configuration rollout allowed queue_capacity=0 without validation.
Status record: 10:00 healthy. 10:05 error rate rose to 100% for queue submissions. 10:06 alert fired. 10:08 engineer reproduced failure. 10:15 corrected config deployed.
10:18 health restored; 10:25 observation window ended with zero submission errors.
